title: Cravings
tagline: Modern responsive food discovery and digital ordering experience
description: Cravings is an interactive, full-stack food delivery and restaurant discovery platform. It delivers rapid menu search, custom dish curation, real-time cart state synchronization, and an intuitive checkout flow built with responsive modern frontend architecture.
problem: Traditional restaurant and food ordering interfaces often suffer from sluggish filter transitions, clunky cart state updates, and poor mobile responsiveness, leading to high cart abandonment.
solution: Engineered an ultra-responsive client experience utilizing atomic UI components, optimistic UI state updates for cart modifications, and granular dish filtering with debounced instant search.
features: Dynamic restaurant and cuisine catalog with instant dietary filters
Interactive dish customizer with real-time price calculation
Optimistic cart state management with local persistence fallback
Order status timeline tracker with realistic multi-stage state transitions
Responsive mobile-first navigation and checkout workflow
architectureSummary: Client-side state synchronization with modular API handlers and responsive presentation components.

title: Real-Time Communication App
tagline: WebSocket-powered instant messaging and team collaboration workspace
description: A high-performance real-time messaging application supporting instant 1-on-1 and channel communications, live user presence indicators, typing feedback, and resilient connection recovery.
problem: Standard HTTP polling introduces significant network overhead and latency in active collaborative workspaces, degrading user trust in real-time communication.
solution: Designed a bi-directional WebSocket event architecture backed by Node.js and Express, enabling sub-100ms message delivery, heartbeat presence detection, and optimistic message delivery queues.
features: Bidirectional instant message dispatch via WebSockets
Live user presence (online/away/offline) with heartbeat pings
Real-time typing awareness indicators and delivered/read receipts
Channel-based group rooms and private direct messaging
Optimistic UI updates with automatic retry upon temporary disconnections
architectureSummary: Event-driven WebSocket gateway paired with modular UI chat stream components and optimistic local queue.

challenges: Handling graceful socket reconnections during transient mobile network drops without duplicate messages
Managing scroll retention when fetching historical chat segments asynchronously

title: Form Builder
tagline: Interactive drag-and-drop digital form builder with live schema generation
description: An intuitive web application allowing users to dynamically compose complex custom forms with custom validation rules, conditional logic, live form previews, and JSON schema import/export.
problem: Building custom data collection forms typically requires repetitive frontend and backend coding cycles for validation and UI layout.
solution: Built a drag-and-drop visual builder that compiles user configurations into standardized JSON schemas, instantly rendering dynamic form fields with automated validation hooks.
features: Interactive field palette (text, email, select, checkbox, radio, date, file)
Real-time drag-and-drop canvas reordering
Configurable validation rules (regex patterns, required toggles, min/max lengths)
Dual-mode live preview with interactive form test-submissions
Schema JSON export and instant form template cloning
architectureSummary: Schema-driven state pipeline translating field layout definitions into responsive, validated form elements.

title: Voting Management System
tagline: Secure full-stack digital voting platform with verified ballot counting
description: A robust digital voting management application engineered for election workflows, cryptographic ballot integrity, candidate management, and real-time auditable vote analytics.
problem: Conventional organizational voting faces issues with voter verification, physical ballot distribution costs, and opacity in election counting.
solution: Engineered an end-to-end voting application with strict one-vote constraints, candidate ballot configurations, and instant tabulation graphs.
features: Voter credential authentication with single-ballot verification
Interactive ballot sheet with instant candidate profile review
Real-time election tally graphs and percentage breakdowns
Administrator election creation, candidate nomination, and audit logs
Responsive voter interface with confirm-vote safety dialogs
architectureSummary: Relational database backed voting engine with strict transaction isolation and RESTful API endpoints.
